subject: Supply Chain & Logistics
title: Exponential Smoothing
description: Learn Exponential Smoothing in one minute.

hook.text: Yesterday matters more than last month. Last month matters more than last year. That's the core idea.

buildup.text: Exponential smoothing weights recent data more heavily than older data using a decay factor called alpha.

discovery.text: A high alpha (0.8) reacts fast to changes. A low alpha (0.2) smooths aggressively and ignores noise.

twist.text: Choosing the right alpha is part science, part art. Too reactive chases noise; too smooth misses trends.

climax.text: Exponential smoothing is the backbone of most inventory planning systems. Simple, fast, and effective.

punchline.text: Weight the recent past more. That's smarter forecasting.
